name: Folate
overview: Folate is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include folate, also known as vitamin b9 and folacin, is one of the b vitamins; folate is required for the body to make dna and rna and metabolise amino acids necessary for cell division and maturation of blood cells; as the human body cannot make folate, it is required in the diet, making it an essential nutrient. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
